title: Rene Baterbonia's parents donate son's jersey to Boss Toyo: 'Kusa't walang kapalit'
summary: An Ateneo de Davao jersey worn by the late Rene Clert “Bobet” Baterbonia has been entrusted to Boss Toyo of “Pinoy Pawn Stars” to be preserved as part of his museum’s memorabilia collection.
